description: This file defines the NetworkManager plugin class for WPEFramework, including its interface, notification handling, JSON-RPC methods, and internal data caching. It manages network interface states, IP configurations, WiFi status, and internet connectivity, exposing these functionalities via plugin interfaces and RPC mechanisms.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing network interfaces, notifications, and RPC methods.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class handling network and connection notifications, interfacing with the parent NetworkManager.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).
